initial_conditions: The saved Harbor revision 23 on the Apple Silicon studio with both editable patterns and its default rest arrangement.
actions: Open Harbor revision 23 and use Frame all in 2D.
Zoom into the 3D rest arrangement until it clips. Save a workspace PNG.
Choose Frame garment in View and save the fitted rest arrangement.
Select Harbor front in Scene, use Isolate selected and complete one manual Step while Harbor back is hidden.
Zoom into the accepted 3D surface until it clips and save a workspace PNG.
Press Command-K, enter Frame garment, then activate the single result with Tab and Return. Save the fitted workspace.
Export GLB while Harbor back is hidden and compare it with the prior full one-step export.
expected_outcomes: The View and Command search routes fit the clipped 3D cloth with a margin. The 2D canvas and Properties pixels, editable bytes and complete one-step GLB are preserved.
